scientific_scope: Actual file reads and frozen inherited content inference on synthetic marked-symbol tasks; finite CTMC cells and finite TRAIN-fitted task Bellman model; not native production Hepta
task_objective: Terminal correct-minus-incorrect reward minus priced queries minus declared task elapsed time. Measured hardware CPU enters a separate admission sensitivity; it is not a teacher Q input or task duration.
boundary_scope: Fixed and TRAIN-selected posterior-confidence task boundaries share the task owner. They do not identify the intrinsic neural cell free-boundary effect.
sampled_execution: Frozen distribution-trained analytic_value critic is additionally deployed on one Gillespie CTMC path per session, without retraining. Auxiliary migration diagnostic, excluded from the five primary contrasts.
uncertainty: Two-sided Student t intervals across five paired training seeds, Bonferroni for five contrasts separately within each split; episodes are not independent training replications
admission: No main activation unless D-B lower simultaneous bound is positive in IID and OOD, completed-job accuracy is noninferior, measured CPU-adjusted utility is positive at 0.01 utility/CPU-second including training amortized over 1000 sessions, and native integration is independently qualified
source_freeze: Publish protocol, implementation and selected trained models before creating either heldout cohort. Preserve aborted runs and raw results; never retune on confirmation.
